summary: BOTTOM LINE: Campaign c2 is the most urgent threat — it is calling an armed gathering at Maujpur Chowk at 17:00 IST on Wednesday 26 February and is escalated to URGENT. Two coordinated incitement campaigns (c1: 29 accounts, c2: 18 accounts) are actively spreading inflammatory content under #DelhiRiots on X, targeting residents and youth in the Jaffrabad, Maujpur, and Babarpur areas of North East Delhi. Campaign c2 specifically directs people to assemble with lathis and sticks and blockade the area near the Mandir at Maujpur Chowk — a concrete, time-bound call to violent offline action that requires immediate ground-level response before 17:00 IST on 26 February. Campaign c1 (severity 4/5) is also URGENT and continues to incite violence against individuals described as rioters and stone pelters in the same localities. A third campaign (c3, 12 accounts) coordinating around a disputed viral video linked to a named individual is assessed as benign coordination and requires only routine monitoring at this time. This summary is automated decision support and should be verified by a human analyst before operational action is taken.
